business_summary: Kunming Yunnei Power Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of diesel engines for commercial vehicles, passenger cars, and off-road machinery in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company engine products, such as DEV series diesel engine, YN series diesel engine, diesel engine for offroad machines, dual fuel engine, and natural gas engine; parts assembly, system, natural gas parts, and universal parts; and heavy duty gear, CI series, CH-4 series, and CD diesel engine oil products. It also provides gas and new energy bus; frame and carriage assembly; agricultural machinery products, generator sets, and remanufactured engine. In addition, the company offers nanometer ceramic thermal insulation film for automobiles; nanometer ceramic thermal insulation film for buildings; high transmittance heat insulation float glass; and deep processing products. Further, it engages in the production and sales of hydrogen fuel cell systems, non road diesel engines and spare parts, and gasoline engines; production, sales, and service of g- series commercial vehicle gasoline engine powertrain products and sensors; development, production, and sales of industrial- grade electronic products and electromechanical products; provision of technology research and development, technical consulting, and technical services for automotive power products; and offers intelligent agricultural machinery and equipment, intelligent power transmission and distribution and control equipment. Kunming Yunnei Power Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Kunming, the People's Republic of China.
